build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && python -m spacy download fr_core_news_sm && cd backend && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

deploy.startCommand: cd backend && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py loaddata faq/fixtures/categories.json faq/fixtures/faq.json && gunicorn config.wsgi --bind [::]:$PORT --workers 2 --timeout 120
